items.name: Going Fast in Idaho 2022
items.information: Please be sure to familiarize yourself with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), the WCA [Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf), and our [Risk Management Plan](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1veNWzPcM9sTuWmuBfvyzVbQxbvoNDuIZ-0w6SAyFbz4/edit?usp=sharing) for this competition. Masks are required while competiting, judging, scrambling, etc. Masks are highly recommended for everyone while in the venue. Competitors may only bring one spectator with them. Most competitors will be expected to be a judge or runner. Please look through the [Competing](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoingFastinIdaho2022#17331-competing) and [Judging and Running](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GoingFastinIdaho2022#17332-judging-and-running) tabs before registering. Competitors are encouraged to bring their own pens.

items.information: REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição; 2. Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial; 3. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 4. Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (lojagcubos@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante; 5. Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição; 6. Em virtude do COVID-19, o local só irá comportar um número máximo de 30 competidores e 30 convidados; 7. Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (lojagcubos@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org). REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer; 2. Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition; 3. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind. 4. Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (lojagcubos@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name; 5. Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition; 6. Due to COVID-19, the venue will only hold a maximum of 30 competitors and 30 guests 7. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (lojagcubos@gmail.com), or the delegate via email (gsantos@worldcubeassociation.org).

items.name: Palmerston North 2022
items.information: Palmerston North 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
